Ahhh got it. You’re thinking of the line the **Black guy says to Kane (the Chinese roommate)** in *Grandma’s Boy* when he first meets him.

He looks at him and says:

### **“I’m… Chinese.”**

And Kane just stares at him with that straight face.

Then the guy awkwardly follows it with:

### **“I can do Chinese.”**

It’s one of the funniest awkward introductions in the whole movie.

Yes, I know exactly the moment you mean.  
It’s the scene where **the African guy tries to bond with Kane, the Chinese roommate**, and he delivers that awkward, iconic line.

Here’s what he says:

### **He looks at Kane and says:**  
**“I’m from Africa.”**

Kane doesn’t respond.

So he tries again and adds:

### **“I’m… Chinese.”**  
(trying to relate, even though it makes no sense)

Then he follows it up with:

### **“I can do Chinese.”**

It’s intentionally awkward, and Kane just keeps staring silently, which makes it even funnier.

It sounds like you’re trying to remember the name of the **Chinese character from the movie “Grandma’s Boy.”**

The character you’re thinking of is:

### **Kang**
He’s the *silent, mysterious, kung-fu-vibe* roommate in the film. Some people remember his name sounding like **“Kane”** or **“Kung.”**  

There’s also another character people mix up:

### **Mr. Cheezle**
The older Zen boss with the robe. His last name sometimes gets misheard as “Chi,” “Cheezus,” or “Cheezle.”

If you’re thinking of a **word like “Lamugeus”**, you might be thinking of:

### **“Shen / Shifu / Sensei”**  
People sometimes use these when thinking of martial arts style characters, even though that’s not from the movie.

If you want, tell me what scene or personality you’re thinking of and I can pinpoint it exactly.

If you mean **Kang**, the quiet Chinese roommate in *Grandma’s Boy*, the joke is that he **never actually speaks English** in the movie.  

His only memorable “line” is that **long, intense martial-arts style chant** in the kitchen when he’s doing his moves. It sounds like:

### **“La-moo-gay-us!”**  
or  
### **“La-moo-geh-ssaa!”**

People remember it differently because it’s not a real word. It’s just a dramatic, made-up kung-fu noise for comedic effect.

So if you’re trying to recall the exact sound:  
**It’s basically him yelling a fake kung-fu chant that sounds like “LAMUGAISSS!”**

There are **a few Black characters in *Grandma’s Boy*** and each has a funny line, so I need to know **which one you mean**. Here are the main possibilities people ask about:

## ⭐ **1. The Delivery Driver / Friend Who Says “Did he just call me a monkey?”**  
This is one of the most quoted lines.  
He says:

### **“Did he just call me a monkey?!”**

This happens when JP is glitching around acting weird and says “I’m thinking about getting metal legs” and the guy thinks JP insulted him.

When they’re all high at Dante’s house, he says:

### **“I can’t feel my legs.”**  
and  
### **“Where are my legs?!”**

This is another scene people remember.
